alert_name: Lateral Movement via SMB - Admin Share Access

raw.detail: Access to ADMIN$ share on HR-SRV-02 from FIN-WKS-03 with PsExec-like service creation

evidence: User admin-ops authenticated from FIN-WKS-03 (10.20.5.7) to HR-SRV-02 (10.20.5.32) over SMB using network logon (type 3).
Access to the ADMIN$ administrative share was followed by creation of a service named PSEXESVC (event 7045), a common PsExec signature.
A binary svc-update.exe was written to C:\Windows on the destination, consistent with lateral tool transfer.
The sequence of events 5145 (share access), 7045 (service install), and 4624 (logon) within seconds indicates remote execution rather than interactive admin work.
Pending validation: whether admin-ops was performing an authorized maintenance task during a change window.
